title: The Salvage Paramount
logline: When an insured luxury liner crashes in deep asteroids, an insurance recovery agent and a cutthroat scrapper crew engage in an armed race to claim the bearer bond vault before title lapses.

roles.description: Retained by underwriters to recover insured bearer bonds from the crash site before third parties claim derelict title.
Runs a rogue scrapper flotilla claiming paramount salvage rights under deep-space maritime custom.
A heavily modified industrial cutter bristling with tractor beams and short-range pulse cannons.
The shattered hull of a luxury liner wedged in a tumbling carbonaceous asteroid.
An unchartered staging dock where unregistered wreckage is cut up and retagged.
A maritime insurance syndicate desperate to recover high-net-worth collateral before paying out catastrophic loss claims.

public_situation: Underwriters and salvage cutters converge on an asteroid belt in {system} after an insured luxury vessel impacts a tumbling rock.
private_truth: The liner's purser deliberately scuttled the ship to fake the loss of a dynastic bearer bond chest held in the vault.

beats.public_change: Underwriters announce an emergency recovery bounty for verifiable salvage rights at {role:wrecked_transport}.

missions.reason: The recovery agent needs a telemetry sweep of the impact crater to confirm the vault's biometric locks are still intact before scrapper torches breach them.
missions.private_fact: The recovery agent intends to pocket half the unregistered bonds and claim they were incinerated in the reactor flare.

beats.public_change: Scrapper cutters deploy interdiction drones across the asteroid field to enforce paramount salvage jurisdiction.

missions.reason: The recovery agent contracts the pilot to disable the scrapper command cutter before its boarding team penetrates the passenger decks.
missions.private_fact: The scrapper crew includes escaped debt-laborers who will face life imprisonment if captured by syndicate marshals.

beats.public_change: A rogue salvage shuttle flees the wreck carrying the severed vault core toward an unchartered depot.

missions.reason: The pilot must shoot down the fleeing scrapper transport and retrieve the armored bond chest before it drops into the deep system.
missions.private_fact: The bond chest carries genetic traces proving the liner was abandoned by its officers before collision.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the recovered bearer bond chest while scrapper survivors and underwriters wait on comms.

options.label: Deliver the chest to the underwriting syndicate, closing the insurance claim and collecting the corporate fee
Split the bearer bonds with the salvage boss at the secret depot, letting underwriters pay the total loss
Turn the bond keys over to the deceased passengers' estate representatives for an independent restitution fund

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the bearer bond chest to the underwriters syndicate.
resolutions.summary: {role:underwriters_syndicate} recovers the assets and closes the claim; {role:recovery_agent} collects a massive commission while the scrapper ring dissolves.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot reclaimed an insured liner's fortune from deep-space asteroid scrappers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot splits the bearer bonds with the salvage boss.
resolutions.summary: {role:salvage_boss} fences the bearer bonds through black-market channels; underwriters take catastrophic losses and transit insurance rates spike.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the bond keys to the victim estate representatives.
resolutions.summary: Passenger families receive direct financial restitution from the vault; both {role:underwriters_syndicate} and {role:salvage_boss} are shut out of the spoils.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the combat drops or the scrapper fleet escapes.
resolutions.summary: Scrappers gut the liner vault and melt down the hull; underwriters declare a total loss and write off the sector.

loose_threads.detail: The luxury liner vault lock was opened from the inside three minutes prior to asteroid impact.
The bearer bond serial numbers match debts previously held by a defunct orbital development bank.

radio_hooks: Armed standoff reported between insurance wardens and scrap cutters in {system} asteroid field.
{role:underwriters_syndicate} posts heavy recovery bounty on passenger liner assets.
Black-market exchanges report sudden influx of bearer securities following luxury hull loss.

voice_direction.recovery_agent: Crisp, predatory, counting seconds between sentences and treating tactical combat as an annoying line item on an invoice.
voice_direction.salvage_boss: Gravelly, boisterous, peppering demands with archaic maritime law citations and broad, theatrical humor.
